title: free-claude-code: a local proxy that intercepts Claude Code traffic and reroutes it to free models

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: watching your anthropic API bill skyrocket from terminal AI agents. Freeclaw code is a drop-in proxy layer. A local fast API server intercepts claude code traffic and routes it to free or local backends. NVIDIA NIM's free tier, DeepSsee, Open Router, LM Studio, Olama dynamically translates responses back into Anthropic's exact SSE format. No patching, no forking. Change two environment variables and your AI coding assistant runs
